title: Chladni - Industrial IoT Asset Performance SaaS
use_case: Multi-screen SaaS product UI (app shell, not marketing): floating icon-rail sidebar with avatar, search-first top bar with '/' shortcut, uppercase display page titles with muted subtitle and right-aligned action buttons (Filter, Export, List/Map segmented toggle), a full-bleed Explorer panel with a floating detail card (status pill, name, timestamp, big health % with area sparkline, 2x3 stats grid, CTA), a drill-down page with breadcrumb, title + health pill, two device summary cards, a 6-tab strip and a 2-col grid of status cards, a Devices page with a 3-col card grid and pagination, a filter bar of dropdowns, and a nested 'line' card with collapsible child list. Best template for any operations console, monitoring dashboard, trading workstation, incident/ticket system or agent session UI that needs sessions -> detail -> log screens.
source: Upwork portfolio - Chladni industrial IoT platform
